definitions.ask: May the acceptance phase change the Mac clipboard over SSH when the Mac has been idle for 10+ minutes?
definitions.why: Only real copies can measure Alfred's lag, and the idle gate keeps them out of active use

choices.label: Measures Alfred's real lag and ordering; leaves about 15 marker clips in Alfred history
Never touches the clipboard; ordering, timing, and wait tuning stay on Bryan's checklist

definitions.ask: How should ~/bin/paste_parts treat clipboard managers now that bob reads Alfred?
definitions.why: Stops resurrecting a retired Clipy without adding unverified pasteboard code

choices.label: Stops killing and relaunching Clipy; its chunk copies keep landing in Alfred history
Also marks each chunk TransientType so Alfred should skip it; needs a Mac check
No change; running it relaunches a retired Clipy, which the Alfred pin makes harmless
